how.heading: Which of these could be true?

profile.framing: Every question about another person: 'Which of these could be true?' multi-select, in their shoes.
profile.rules: listening talk leads the plan if 2+ Today picks; dontknow if expect != 'Clearly agreed, in writing' and since != 'Still happens, more than once'; else cant if role Bigger/Different, or brought has 'Cheap or available'/'Friend or family' without 'Skilled'; else notsetup if volume Heavier, systems New/Fewer, reports Changed, lead changed, paylife Changed, person Changed; else wont if since='Still happens, more than once'; else dontknow

dontknow.label: Doesn't know yet (expectation unclear)
steps: Write what 'done' looks like in 3 lines
Go over it together, then ask for questions
Check once at the end of the week
test: Whether it's met within the week
dontknow.opener: I don't think I ever made this clear. Here's what done looks like.

cant.label: Can't yet (skill)
steps: Show it once, watch them do it once
Pair them with someone strong at it
Check the first 3, then step back
test: Show once, watch once, check once
How close it comes to right
cant.opener: This part is newer. Let's work through it together.

notsetup.label: Not set up (load, tools, or role)
steps: Ask what's getting in the way
Take one thing off their plate
Fix one tool or step slowing them
test: Remove one task for a week
notsetup.opener: A lot has changed since day one. What would help most?

wont.label: Won't (after it was made clear)
steps: Put the expectation and next step in writing
Have one private, direct, kind talk
Set a check-back date, and keep it
wont.opener: This has come up before. Let's get clear on what happens next.

direction.In a quick talk: Keep the talk short and specific
direction.Being shown: Show it, don't just say it

disagree.Go quiet: Ask, then wait. Quiet isn't agreement
disagree.Go along, then don't: Ask them to say it back

driver.Pride in the work: Point to work they're proud of
driver.Money: Tie it to pay or bonus
driver.Freedom in how: Agree the result; let them choose how

adds.longtime: Start with what they've done well for years
adds.longtime_note: One bad stretch doesn't erase years of good work.

talk.title: My conversation plan
talk.fact_none: Pick one recent example. Just what happened, nothing about why.
talk.agree: "For one week, let's try this: {test}. We'll both watch for: {watch}."
talk.checkback: "Let's sit down again on {date}. Same time, 10 minutes."

dontknow.own: "I don't think I ever made this clear. That's on me."
dontknow.ask: "What does 'done' look like to you on this?"
dontknow.backup: "If you had to guess, what matters most to me here?"
dont: "How many times do I have to say it?"
dontknow.defensive: Pause. "I'm not here to blame. I'm here to get us clear."

cant.own: "I put this on your plate without real training. That's on me."
cant.ask: "Which part of this feels newest or hardest?"
cant.backup: "If we started over, where would help matter most?"
cant.defensive: "This is a skill, not a grade. Let's build it together."

notsetup.own: "A lot changed since day one, and I didn't adjust with it."
notsetup.ask: "What's getting in the way right now?"
notsetup.backup: "If one thing came off your plate, what would it be?"
notsetup.defensive: "I'm asking because I want to fix the setup, not you."

wont.own: "I needed to be clearer and more direct, sooner."
wont.ask: "Help me understand what's going on with this."
wont.backup: "What would make this work for you?"
dont: Any threat made in the heat of the moment.
wont.defensive: "I hear you. And this still needs to change by {date}."

employee.tip: Private, short, early in the day.

longtime.tip: Open with thanks for the years. Mean it.
longtime.own_prefix: "You've carried a lot here for years. I see that."

partner.tip: Meet as equals, away from the shop.
partner.ask: "Where do you want this business to be in two years?"

vendor.tip: Keep it to the account: dates, specs, payment.
vendor.ask: "What would help you deliver on time for us?"

customer.tip: Lead with the work and what was promised.
customer.ask: "What would make this right for you?"

family.tip: Pick a calm time. Not at dinner, not in front of others.
